title: Fruit Golf Assets
description:
Here are a couple character assets made for Coal Car Studio's mobile VR game "Fruit Golf"

I was responsible for concepting, modelling, texturing, rigging, and animating these characters (Floppy Shark and Giant Octopus). They are an incredible group of creative people, and it was a pleasure doing work with them. [fruitgolf.com](https://www.fruitgolf.com/)
